event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'Digital Sovereignty Starts in the Classroom' in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Digital sovereignty is often discussed at institutional and enterprise level, but its foundations are built much earlier: in education. Emanuele Solferino, FSFE Volunteer, will talk about how Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) can empower students and schools to regain control over their digital tools, data and learning processes.

Through a real-world experience — the “Free Software in High Schools” project developed in collaboration with Free Software Foundation Europe — this session presents practical insights, challenges and outcomes from introducing FOSS in a secondary school environment.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 3.
